note: 116: the strategist's parameter sweep (scripts/tune/agent_sweep.py, scripts/tune/README.md). Each parameter is an agent-spec key, its hand-set value (the strategist's default: the script checks it plays the same as plain `strategist`) and the grid the search walks. Seeds come from the ledger in docs/experiments.md: give a later revision fresh ones with --sweep-seed and --confirm-seed.

params.says: an insight a seat holds, in heuristic points
an energy held (and, through plan_rates, the keep plan's price of energy)
a credit held, up to credit_cap
a card's worth: heuristic points per value-table credit (cards in hand, drafted, built)
income valued over the rounds left: this x its weight x the rounds
credits a seat holds beyond this are worth credit_idle (0.15) each
keep threshold: the share of a card's keep price charged against drafting it
keep threshold: what a credit paid for a keep costs the keep plan
the strategy weights: how far a strategy's multipliers reach from 1 (0: every multiplier 1; the strategy is still chosen and plan_reach still reads its tags)
